articles.title: PeopleSoft 0-day affecting hundreds of organizations steals gigabytes of data
articles.summary: Vulnerability in the Oracle-owned PeopleSoft software is about as critical as they come.

articles.title: Over 400 Arch Linux packages compromised to push rootkit, infostealer
articles.summary: More than 400 packages in the Arch User Repository (AUR) are distributing a Linux rootkit and infostealer malware targeting credentials and access tokens.

articles.title: Google Sues Chinese Smishing Network Accused of Using Gemini AI in Phishing

articles.title: China-Linked Hackers Backdoored Linux Login Software to Hide for Nearly a Decade
articles.summary: Instead of hiding on the laptops and servers defenders watch most closely, a China-nexus group spent close to a decade hidden inside the Linux login system itself.

articles.title: Over 400 Arch Linux AUR Packages Hijacked to Deploy Infostealer and eBPF Rootkit
articles.summary: Attackers took over more than 400 packages in the Arch User Repository (AUR) this week and rewrote their build scripts to install a credential stealer on any machine that built them.

articles.title: China-Linked Hackers Backdoored Linux Login Software to Hide for Nearly a Decade
articles.summary: A China-linked group backdoored Linux login software to hide for nearly a decade, allowing them to maintain access to targeted networks.

articles.title: June 2026 Patch Tuesday: Microsoft Patches 206 Vulnerabilities Including Three Publicly Disclosed Zero-Days
articles.summary: Microsoft's June 2026 Patch Tuesday update addresses 206 vulnerabilities, including three publicly disclosed zero-days.

articles.title: Oracle Mitigates PeopleSoft Zero-Day Exploited in Data Theft Attacks
articles.summary: Oracle has mitigated a critical PeopleSoft Suite zero-day vulnerability actively exploited in ShinyHunter data theft attacks.

articles.title: Check Point VPN Flaw Exploited Since Early May
articles.summary: A critical zero-day vulnerability in Check Point VPN has been exploited since early May, with a Qilin ransomware affiliate blamed for at least one incident.

articles.title: AI Agent Discovers 21 Zero-Days in FFmpeg
articles.summary: An AI agent has discovered 21 previously unknown vulnerabilities in FFmpeg, a widely used media library.

articles.title: Ivanti, Fortinet, and SAP Release Patches for Multiple Critical Vulnerabilities
articles.summary: Ivanti, Fortinet, and SAP have released security updates to address multiple critical vulnerabilities that could result in arbitrary code execution and information disclosure.

articles.title: CISA Adds Cisco, Chrome, and Arista Flaws to KEV Catalog Amid Active Exploitation
articles.summary: CISA has added three new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, including flaws in Cisco, Chrome, and Arista products.

articles.title: CISA Orders Feds to Patch Actively Exploited Ivanti Flaw
articles.summary: The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has ordered government agencies to patch an actively exploited Ivanti Sentry flaw within three days.

articles.title: ShinyHunters Uses Oracle Zero-Day to Target Higher Ed
articles.summary: The ShinyHunters group has exploited an Oracle zero-day vulnerability to target higher education institutions, resulting in significant data theft.

articles.title: Authorities dismantle 'AudiA6' ransomware crypto-laundering service
articles.summary: Law enforcement dismantled the 'AudiA6' cryptocurrency service allegedly used by ransomware actors to launder over $380 million.
